scope: Extend deep enum-domain scalar parameter inference across GREATEST and LEAST positions
engine: PostgreSQL 16 Alpine in Docker via testcontainers
contract: At domain depths 63 and 64, COALESCE, CASE, GREATEST(parameter, column), GREATEST(column, parameter), LEAST(parameter, column), and LEAST(column, parameter) are compared with native untyped-literal inference.
Each context checks text, literal NULL text, empty text and SQL NULL. Assertions compare result text, inferred parameter enum type, expression result type and declared domain type.
Both the regular search_path and a first-position same-named shadow enum search_path are exercised. This proves only these scalar contexts and inputs at the two named depths.

focused_test.command: rtk cargo test --offline --locked --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration deep_enum_scalar_contexts -- --ignored --test-threads=1

remaining: Other session/search_path combinations, domain depths beyond the tested scalar contexts, other consumers, native types and the broader B3 matrix remain open; this case does not qualify 0.2.0.
